notes: 1978 height-and-bulk sheet 10H. Frame: a thick bar across the top (above 'SEE SHEET 8H'; its lower edge drifts from y ~66 at the left to ~91 at the right) and the thick bar that rules off the legend strip at the bottom (top edge y ~3816 left, ~3808 right, slightly bowed). No rule on the left or right: the map is cut straight at x ~60-100 and x ~2950 with blank paper out to the page edges, so those sides follow the page edge (README rule 5). Top side ~2 px under the top bar, bottom side ~2 px above the legend bar, both carried at the bar's height out to both page edges (as in 1980-1990-zoning-p01). No corner arcs, no notches (the legend strip spans the page, so it is simply below the bottom side). No remove polygon: the north arrow and sheet number are in the legend strip, outside. 'SEE SHEET 8H' and 'SEE SHEET 11H' are cross-references, inside; the thin dashed COUNTY LINE ~50 px above the legend bar is map. Doubt: whether the lone top bar counts as a frame rule; treated as one (nearest rule: the outline lies just inside the innermost printed rule), so the paper above it is outside. Ink under the outline: one 1-2 px nub on the legend bar's top edge near x 200-250.
drawn_by: Claude (TC, test set), 2026-11-21: rule edges measured column by column from page.png (thickest/nearest dark run per column), smoothed with a robust local line (+-120 px), outline set 2 px inside the edge, points every ~150-250 px; every vertex checked on full-resolution crops; drawn from the scan and README only (no model output)
